question: How many products are in each category and its subcategories for orders placed in 2023?

  SELECT category_id, name, parent_category_id, 1 AS depth
  FROM categories
  WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.category_id, c.name, c.parent_category_id, ct.depth + 1
  FROM categories c
  INNER JOIN category_tree ct ON c.parent_category_id = ct.category_id
) SELECT ct.category_id, ct.name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count
FROM category_tree ct
JOIN products p ON ct.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2023'
GROUP BY ct.category_id, ct.name, ct.depth
ORDER BY ct.depth, ct.category_id;

question: What is the total revenue for each parent category from orders placed between 2023-01-01 and 2023-12-31?

sql: WITH order_revenue AS ( SELECT p.category_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY p.category_id ), category_cost AS ( SELECT c.category_id, SUM(p.cost * oi.quantity) AS total_cost FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY c.category_id ) SELECT c.name AS category_name, (or.total_revenue - cc.total_cost) AS gross_profit FROM order_revenue or JOIN category_cost cc ON or.category_id = cc.category_id JOIN categories c ON or.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY gross_profit DESC LIMIT 5;
